proof_body:
by
  intro a b
  have hu : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => x⁻¹) Filter.atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_inv_atTop_zero
  have hG : ContinuousAt (fun u : ℝ => (a + b * u) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a * u + b * u ^ 2) + 1)) 0 := by
    apply ContinuousAt.div (by fun_prop) (by fun_prop)
    simp
  have hlim := hG.tendsto.comp hu
  have hval : (a + b * 0) / (Real.sqrt (1 + a * 0 + b * 0 ^ 2) + 1) = a / 2 := by
    norm_num
  rw [hval] at hlim
  have hw : Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => 1 + a * x⁻¹ + b * (x⁻¹) ^ 2) Filter.atTop (nhds (1 + a * 0 + b * 0 ^ 2)) :=
    ((hu.const_mul a).const_add 1).add ((hu.pow 2).const_mul b)
  have hw' : ∀ᶠ x : ℝ in Filter.atTop, 0 < 1 + a * x⁻¹ + b * (x⁻¹) ^ 2 := by
    apply hw.eventually
    exact lt_mem_nhds (by norm_num)
  refine hlim.congr' ?_
  filter_upwards [hw', Filter.eventually_gt_atTop 0] with x hx hx0
  simp only [Function.comp_apply]
  set w := 1 + a * x⁻¹ + b * (x⁻¹) ^ 2 with hwdef
  have hxne : x ≠ 0 := hx0.ne'
  have hs : Real.sqrt w ^ 2 = w := Real.sq_sqrt hx.le
  have hspos : 0 < Real.sqrt w := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hx
  have heq : x ^ 2 + a * x + b = (x * Real.sqrt w) ^ 2 := by
    rw [mul_pow, hs, hwdef]
    field_simp
  rw [heq, Real.sqrt_sq (by positivity)]
  have hne : Real.sqrt w + 1 ≠ 0 := by positivity
  rw [div_eq_iff hne]
  have : (x * Real.sqrt w - x) * (Real.sqrt w + 1) = x * (Real.sqrt w ^ 2 - 1) := by ring
  rw [this, hs, hwdef]
  field_simp
  ring
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun x : ℝ => Real.sqrt (x ^ 2 + a * x + b) - x) Filter.atTop (nhds (a / 2))
